name: LESYA•FINELINE MINI TATTOO
bio:
Renowned for their exceptional dexterity in minimalist, fineline tattooing, Lesya Spicy has swiftly become a sought-after artist in Moscow's body art community. Transforming eight years of office precision to the craft of tattooing, Lesya's commitment to professionalism ensures each design is executed with meticulous detail and care, truly setting the standard for fine art on skin. Whether you're seeking a delicate single needle creation or an intricate minitattoo, Lesya Spicy's studio is the epitome of excellence in modern tattooing.
